research_result.description: NotebookLM (also referred to as Gemini Notebook) is Google's AI-powered research and document-synthesis tool that offers source-grounded reasoning, Q&A, and content artifact generation.
research_result.credential_requirements: Official REST API access is restricted to enterprise accounts requiring a Google Cloud project, enterprise licensing (e.g., Gemini Enterprise), and admin configuration. Consumer users have no public API key access and rely on cookie-based browser session extraction for community tooling.
research_result.main_blocker: Official API access requires Google Cloud enterprise licensing and administrator setup; consumer access lacks an official API and relies on cookie-authenticated community MCP servers.

evidence.claim: NotebookLM Enterprise API exposes REST endpoints through Google Cloud Discovery Engine v1alpha service.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The API, available only to enterprise customers, exposes REST endpoints through Google Cloud’s Discovery Engine v1alpha service [9].

evidence.claim: There is no official public consumer API for NotebookLM.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: If you've searched for "NotebookLM API," here's the short answer: there is no public consumer API.

evidence.claim: nblm-rs client supports authentication via gcloud CLI, environment variables, and OAuth2.
An MCP server for NotebookLM is available providing programmatic access and tools for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: notebooklm-mcp-cli takes a similar approach but packages it as both a CLI and an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

evidence.claim: Enterprise usage requires Google Cloud plan authorization from an administrator.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can upgrade Gemini Notebook to get additional capabilities, including higher limits and more features through Google AI Plans, Google Cloud, or a qualifying Google Workspace plan.
